safetyNotes: This route is descriptive, not a guarantee of safety or access.
Event closures and crowd conditions can change access on Nguyen Hue.
Ton Duc Thang separates Nguyen Hue from the riverfront: confirm the designated crossing or pedestrian bridge is open, and never enter traffic for a photo.

quests.title: Old Meets New

fallback.instructions: Confirm that the photo was taken from the public walking-street area.

quests.title: City Reflection
quests.prompt: Find a reflection of the city in glass or water while remaining in the pedestrian area.

fallback.instructions: Skip the quest if events or crowds make the area unsuitable.

fallback.instructions: Confirm that you are inside the public park and add a caption.
